summary: The student interprets a prompt asking for the name of a place as asking for the value represented by the digit in that position.
subject: MATHEMATICS
teachingImplication: Clarify the distinction between positional place-value labels and the quantity represented by a digit.
checkNext: Present an unassisted item asking for the place name of an underlined digit in a multi-digit number.

evidence.task: Name the place of the second 2 in 2258
